zh.title: 懂腦的老師，
zh.sub: 腦細話事 · 校本教師培訓計劃
zh.lead: 一個實用、以腦科學與創傷知情為本的培訓計劃，陪伴學校團隊在每間課室裡，一步一步支持每位孩子學習。
zh.proof: 附有香港理工大學護理學院的研究數據

intro.p1: 我們走進學校，而不是把老師請出校門。導師從老師的真實日常出發，圍繞課堂上真正發生的時刻設計培訓。
intro.p2: 透過腦科學與創傷知情的實踐，老師學會讀懂行為、在壓力下保持穩定，並讓每位孩子感到安全，才能安心學習。

en.title: Teachers who understand brains,
en.sub: Brainy In-Charge · School-Based Teacher Training Programme
en.lead: A hands-on, trauma-informed programme that gives school teams practical tools to support every child’s learning, one classroom at a time.
en.proof: Backed by research data from PolyU Nursing

intro.h: Training that stays in the classroom
intro.p1: We work inside your school, not outside it. Our trainers meet your teachers where they are and build skills around the real moments of your school day.
intro.p2: Through brain-based and trauma-informed practice, teachers learn to read behaviour, stay steady under pressure and help every child feel safe enough to learn.
